g.title: gapnote
g.text: GAP — implemented + tested, NOT wired into the trainer.
Wiring it moves the micro loop host-side (into the
face_transforms callable, the only mid-elimination hook
IncrementalJaxpr offers) and reshapes the PPO trajectory.

g.title: sent
g.text: no work (muls≤0 & flops≤0) or no Jacobian (cos≤1e-6)
(a zero-work plan is INVALID, not cheap)
